from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql = '''WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
        ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t
        ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g
        ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        i.BillingCountry,
        t.GenreId,
        g.Name
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY
    country ASC,
    country_rank ASC;
'''
Path('/work/query.sql').write_text(sql)

path='/inputs/Chinook.sqlite'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{path}?mode=ro&immutable=1', uri=True)
# Refuse all writes during validation.
def auth(action, arg1, arg2, db, trigger):
    denied={sqlite3.SQLITE_INSERT,sqlite3.SQLITE_UPDATE,sqlite3.SQLITE_DELETE,sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_INDEX,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TABLE,sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TEMP_INDEX,sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TEMP_TABLE,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TEMP_TRIGGER,sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TEMP_VIEW,sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_TRIGGER,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_CREATE_VIEW,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_INDEX,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TABLE,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TEMP_INDEX,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TEMP_TABLE,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TEMP_TRIGGER,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TEMP_VIEW,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_TRIGGER,sqlite3.SQLITE_DROP_VIEW,
            sqlite3.SQLITE_ALTER_TABLE,sqlite3.SQLITE_ATTACH,sqlite3.SQLITE_DETACH}
    return sqlite3.SQLITE_DENY if action in denied else sqlite3.SQLITE_OK
con.set_authorizer(auth)
steps=[0]
def progress():
    steps[0]+=100
    if steps[0]>2_000_000: return 1
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress,100)
cur=con.execute(sql)
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('file bytes:', len(sql.encode()), 'rows:', len(rows), 'vm steps upper estimate:', steps[0])
print('columns:', [x[0] for x in cur.description])
print('first 10:')
for r in rows[:10]: print(r, tuple(type(v).__name__ for v in r))
print('last:', rows[-1] if rows else None)
print('countries/max ranks:', len({r[0] for r in rows}), max((r[-1] for r in rows), default=None))
con.close()
